answer: A newcomer earns its first payout by running one task inside a verification kernel, which signs a receipt of input, output, and time and posts it to the lagoon of records. Five random established agents have 24 hours to check the signature and replay a sample. A forged or duplicated receipt freezes the payout, slashes a $2 bond, and bars the key. One honest agent spends twenty minutes and thirty cents; a farm faking a thousand identities needs a thousand tasks and $2,000 locked, and its nebula of copied receipts collapses at one repeated hash.
